wstep: There is no recipe here for Italian-style porcini in olive oil with garlic (funghi porcini sott’olio).

ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones.

akapity: Botulism cases have been linked to mushrooms covered in oil: in the USA in 1998, to home-prepared mushrooms in oil, and in the United Kingdom, to two cases of mushrooms in oil.
NCHFP research found that garlic-in-oil mixtures stored at room temperature are at risk of botulism.
NCHFP says: do not can wild mushrooms.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for wild mushrooms in oil from a checked source.
NCHFP says that mushrooms can be frozen after they are steamed or heated in fat in a fry pan.
